content._comment: DocFX builds only the API reference, plus toc.yml for the top bar of the API pages. The guide and the home page are built by VitePress, which merges this output in at api/ - see DOCS.md.

The landing page for the generated API section. docs/api/ is generated and gitignored, so the source sits outside it and is published into it. Without this, /api/ has no index and 404s - DocFX's own nav resolves 'api/' through the toc at runtime, which a direct link cannot do.
